contract.intent: Envision + Grilling engines (S2) — runs the envision step (F8: imagine usage + look, produce the vision artifact) and the validate/grilling step (F4: the idea exit gate, validation + questions; requirements-grilling template + LLM to PRD). Refuses to invent facts or fake precision on novel work (design §21.6).
acceptanceCriteria: Envision: vision artifact (usage + look) per F8; batch-ask questions (flow-control v4 table)
Grilling: validation + questions per F4; requirements-grilling (template + LLM) to PRD artifact
Never invents facts: every output carries provenance (design §6)
Provider calls go through the provider adapter interface (frozen interface — no direct provider access)
